changes.comment: sdk-ui-charts: Add public `config.tooltip.zIndex` to set the z-index of chart tooltips. Charts inside a GoodData.UI overlay now place tooltips above that overlay automatically, and dashboard tooltips stay above the sticky filter bar. The `.highcharts-tooltip-container` z-index CSS rules were removed; if you relied on them, set `config.tooltip.zIndex` instead. stylelint-config: Disallow z-index on `.highcharts-tooltip-container` rules.
